g.text: Theorem plus_O_n'' : forall n : nat, 0 + n = n.Proof. intros m. reflexivity. Qed.Theorem plus_1_l : forall n:nat, 1 + n = S n.Proof. intros n. reflexivity. Qed.Theorem mult_0_l : forall n:nat, 0 * n = 0.Proof. intros n. reflexivity. Qed.

intros can choose a different variable name.intros, simpl, and reflexivity are tactics between Proof and Qed.The suffix _l means “on the left”. Step through the proofs;add simpl to observe how the context and goal change.
